# Snowflake REST APIs reference¶

Snowflake REST APIs provides the following APIs:

- [Account API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/account.html)
- [Alert API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/alert.html)
- [API Integration API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/api-integration.html)
- [Artifact Repository API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/artifact-repository.html)
- [Catalog Integration API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/catalog-integration.html)
- [Code Bundle API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/code-bundle.html)
- [Code Bundle Execution API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/code-bundle-execution.html)
- [Compute Pool API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/compute-pool.html)
- [Cortex Analyst API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/cortex-analyst.html)

- [Cortex Lite Agent API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/cortex-lite-agent.html)
- [Cortex Search Service API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/cortex-search-service.html)

- [User-Defined Function API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/user-defined-function.html)

- [Warehouse API](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/reference/warehouse.html)

Note

The [Snowflake REST APIs reference documentation](https://docs.snowflake.com/developer-guide/snowflake-rest-api/snowflake-rest-api) reflects the latest version of the Snowflake REST APIs. Note that not all resources in the API currently provide 100% coverage of their equivalent [SQL commands](https://docs.snowflake.com/sql-reference-commands), but the Snowflake REST APIs are under active development and are continuously expanding.
